notes.title: Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight - Game Playthrough
notes.notes:
To celebrate the PixElated Festival I'm broadcasting a nearly full playthrough of Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight!

Come discover the secrets that lie within this precision/puzzle platformer!

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
- Key/Controller binds available from Level Select and in Play Scenes
- 3-4 adjusted to make diamond rank easier
- 2-6 Owl pickup won't put Heart in ground
- Skeletons should no longer affect wolves
- 2-5 Owls should no longer respawn in wrong spot after death
- Defeated Wolves should not go behind wall

notes.title: Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight is coming July 15th!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After a long development process, Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight is finished.

Thank you for everyone who has supported me over this journey and I can't wait to finally get this game in your hands.

- Mr. Moo

notes.title: Cosmetics have been added to Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight. Try it out in the demo.
notes.notes:
I hope you all are ready for July 15th! 

Leading up to the release date, I've been stuffing the game with fun content, namely unlockables that can be used to customize your character. Pop up item shops can be found throughout the game that you can purchase with the hidden fireflies found in every level. 

Some cosmetics can only be unlocked through mystery challenges...

More on that to come.

- Mr. Moo

notes.title: Gameplay
notes.notes: Watch what this puzzle action platformer is all about!

notes.title: Can I beat my own game?
notes.notes:
Hello platformer lovers!

Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight is a super tight, puzzle action platformer that will be sure to get you hooked. There is a 3-star and even diamond system based on how fast you can complete levels. Do I have what it takes to beat my own game?

I have been working on this game for several years now, being absolutely obsessed with making the gameplay as fun as can be. It has super tight controls and lots of exciting mechanics. I'll be playing through some of the levels to show you why there is much more to this platformer than meets the eye. Come one, come all!

notes.title: Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello Platformer Lovers (Platformerers?)!

I'm Mr. Moo, the creator of Stolen Hearts: Wolf Knight. While at first glance, this may seem like a generic pixel art platformer, there is more to this game than meets the eye. Hidden collectibles, a 3-star system, lots of fun mechanics, challenging puzzles and platforming, and a story that will be sure to tug on your Heart strings. 

Come join me as play some levels and show you what this game is all about.
